description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named TopNavAdapter for a top navigation bar in an Android TV application. It manages navigation items, including a special search icon, providing focusability and click handling.

classes.name: TopNavAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView ListAdapter managing a list of navigation item strings, including a special search item, with focusability for TV navigation.

classes.name: TopNavVH
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder managing individual navigation item views with focusability, visibility toggling, and click handling.

methods.name: TopNavAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with a list of items and click handler, and submitting the initial list.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item view layout and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a given position.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Configures the item view based on the text; handles special search icon case, sets focusability, description, and click listener.
